event.initial_firm_notification: Two or more of the following: Email, Fax, Letter, Press Release, Telephone, Visit
event.distribution_pattern: Washington, Oregon and California New Seasons Markets

products.product_description: New Seasons Market Creamy Almond Butter 16oz; Label reads in part "***NEW SEASONS WILD FRIENDS FOODS PORTLAND, OR *** IT'S A JAR OF ALMOND BUTTER CREAMY A hint of Jacobsen Sea Salt***" UPC 4060010401;
products.code_info: BEST BY 06/16/2017, BEST BY 08/15/2017, and BEST BY 08/30/2017. The 08/15/2017 lot was added to the recall on 9/13/16, after initiation. Press release contained all three lot codes.
products.reason_for_recall: New Seasons Markets is recalling their brand name Almond Butter due to a labeling error. Some of the jars labeled Almond Butter actually contain Peanut Butter.
